name: accordion-gallery
title: Accordion gallery
description: A rack of modules where one opens to a full card and the rest close to labelled strips; only transforms move, keyboard and touch included.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The module open at first, when uncontrolled.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Open a module when a mouse rests on its strip. Touch and pen open on tap.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level of each strip, so it fits the page's outline.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `auto` stacks the modules vertically when the gallery is narrower than 520 px.

a11y.text: Each module header is a button. Arrow keys move between headers and wrap around, Home and End jump to the first and last. Focus on a header opens its module. With openOnHover (default true), a mouse pointer opens a module after 70 ms.

Each header is a heading (level set by headingLevel, default 3) around a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The open header is aria-disabled because it cannot close. Panels are regions labelled by their header and are inert while closed. The number and dot are aria-hidden.
Under reduced motion the slide, caption and dot transitions are off.
